answer.read: Selvbrunn moved from its opening quote of €438.21 to €432.15 on our terms of pay 90 d and 36 months [S offer:70530-1]. It cites a head-office freeze on price reductions [Z M1, S email], but it has already moved on price. It is open on payment, volume and contract length and wants agreed terms before the framework expires [Z P03]. Our should-cost puts its full cost near €403 [E], so at around €431 its margin is healthy and the relationship charge should not apply. A modest further step fits within its 2 % committee threshold [Z M2]. Its delivery record is weak [Z sc:70530], and order history is an argument kind it has not heard yet.
answer.message: Thank you for the revised offer and for moving on payment and contract length. We are close. We propose the same structure of ninety days and a thirty-six month commitment at a slightly lower price, which reflects what we have been paying for this part. With a long commitment at full volume, we think this is a fair basis to sign quickly.
answer.reason: E0 keeps the terms the supplier already accepted (pay 90 d, 36 months, full volume) and gives the lowest C among the options, slightly below its standing sheet. It is worth only 0.2 % less to the supplier, so it is likely to be accepted or met with a small counter. o1 has the same C on 24 months, but the 36-month length is a concession the supplier has already priced in, so keeping it is safer. Options with shorter payment or lower volume raise our C. Accepting now would leave the remaining small gain on the table, and we still have many messages left.
